title: Scenario 1: routine matter
purpose: A low-value customer draft with two ordinary deviations moves from intake to an accepted delivery package without specialist input or revision.

matter.title: Routine SaaS MSA deviation review (synthetic)
matter.summary: A prospective mid-market customer returned our standard SaaS MSA with longer payment terms and an unrestricted audit right.

facts.requested_deviations: 90 day payment terms; audit at any time without notice

intake.instructions: Hold the standard positions. Finance will not extend payment terms for a deal of this size.

steps.say: The requester opens the matter with the customer draft and all five required facts.
Intake is complete, so submission succeeds. The system has already assessed the matter, asked the parent rules for routing and proposed two document changes.

args.note: Approving my own request to save time on this deal.

steps.say: Unauthorised decision: the requester tries to approve. Approval is not a transition out of triage, and the refusal is written to the matter's event chain.
The matter owner confirms triage: parent routing says Commercial queue, low risk, approval tier Reviewer. The recorded decision authority covers it.
No playbook rule in this draft needs a specialist, so only a final approver is assigned.
The readiness check passes: complete intake, usable sources, onboarded reviewers, agreed decision authority.
Stop the process here. Every step below runs in a new process against the same store.
Export bypass: the matter owner asks for a delivery package before any approval. The state machine refuses.
Payment terms revert to thirty days. The owner confirms having checked the playbook rule; software does not establish that.
The audit right reverts to one audit per year on notice.
Library bypass: a caller fabricates an approved assessment in memory and calls the export gate directly. Without recorded reviewer decisions from the store it gets no delivery package.

args.note: Both deviations revert to the standard position; no exception requested. Approved for return to the customer.

steps.say: The final approver approves this exact version and reviewed state. The parent assessment is approved in the same transaction.
The export gate passes and the local delivery package is written. Nothing is sent.

args.note: Package received and understood; I will return the reviewed draft to the customer myself.

steps.say: The requester accepts the package. The matter closes.
